messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "rarely occurs in children under 12 years of age"
set: ["rarely occurs in children under 12 years of age", "safety and effectiveness not established in children under 6 years of age", "unknown if tumor formation occurs in humans", "can affect growth in children", "some young people up to 24 years of age have thoughts about suicide when first taking this medicine", "steroid medicine can affect growth in children", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "increased risk of seizures in certain conditions", "risk of suicidal thoughts in young people", "kidney, liver, and heart function often decline with age", "safety and effectiveness not established in children and teenagers for any condition other than OCD", "no overall difference in risk of major birth defects", "risk of triggering manic episode in bipolar disorder patients", "may increase risk of neural tube defects in early pregnancy", "increased risk of suicidal thoughts in children, adolescents, and young adults", "risk is particularly high in the first few months of treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
